title: TreeObservation (DRAFT)
description: One immutable record of a tree's condition at a moment, with the evidence supporting it. The series of these is what 'the history of this tree' means. DRAFT — not approved.

observedBy.description: The party who saw the tree — normally the caretaker.

observedAt.description: When the tree was seen, which may precede recordedAt by days if captured offline (ADR-028).

condition.description: Deliberately coarse. A caretaker on a phone should not be asked to grade on a ten-point scale.

measurements.description: All optional. Requiring measurements would make routine check-ins burdensome enough to be skipped.

note.description: Free text from the caretaker. Not shown to sponsors without passing through the story/moderation contract.

evidence.description: TREE-004 and EVID-001: an observation makes a material claim, so at least one verified evidence asset is required. This is what lets a sponsor be shown a photograph rather than an assertion.

supersededByObservationId.description: A correction supersedes; the original observation is never edited or removed.
